entries.description: Anti-CD47 antibody treatment reduces tumor weight in a syngeneic breast cancer model
entries.citation_sentence: As described in the Registered Report (Chroscinski et al., 2015), we attempted a replication of the experiments reported in Figure 6A–C and Supplemental Table S4 of Willingham et al. (2012).
entries.notes: The replication found no significant difference in tumor weight between anti-CD47 and IgG groups (p=0.104), with anti-CD47 tumors actually larger than IgG tumors (0.163g vs 0.075g), opposite to the original finding. The meta-analysis of original and replication effect sizes was not significant (p=0.745) with significant heterogeneity (Cochran's Q p=0.0039).
